images.title: Make the gaps equal
images.purpose: Show a three armed figure with gaps 100, 120 and 140 degrees becoming one with three equal gaps of 120 degrees.
images.composition: Two figures side by side, a wide grey arrow between them, and one short line of text below.
images.exact_structure: Left: one three armed figure with teal #0072B2 arms of equal length from a centre dot, one arm reddish purple #CC79A7, and grey #6B7280 dotted gap arcs of 100, 120 and 140 degrees. Right: the same figure with the 3 arms exactly 120 degrees apart, same colours, and 3 equal dotted gap arcs. Grey arrow from left to right. Exactly 2 figures, 6 arms, 6 arcs.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a right hand figure whose gaps are not equal, or arms of different lengths
images.takeaway: Three equal gaps share the full turn as 120 degrees each.
images.description: A three armed figure with gaps 100, 120 and 140 degrees on the left, and on the right the same figure with three equal gaps of 120 degrees.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the three gaps on each side and say which figure has equal gaps.

image_decisions.why: Making the gaps equal is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
